definitions.explanation: A family unit living together or related by blood.
All members of a family together.

examples.japanese: {一家|いっか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一台|いちだい}→一台：08923_ichidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{田中|たなか}{一家|いっか}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{仲|なか}→仲：09513_naka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。

examples.english: I'm working to support the family.

examples.english: It had been a long time since the whole family ate dinner together, and everyone looked very happy.

notes:
{一家|いっか} refers to a family as a unit — a household living together. It emphasizes the group as a whole rather than individual members.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {一家|いっか}⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧: the whole family, all family members
- {一家|いっか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{一台|いちだい}→一台：08923_ichidai⟧: one per household
- {一家|いっか}⟦そろって→揃う：01953_sorou⟧: the whole family together
- {一家|いっか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支|ささ}える→支える：01946_sasaeru⟧: to support the family
- {一家|いっか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大黒柱|だいこくばしら}→大黒柱：18511_daikokubashira⟧: breadwinner, pillar of the family

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧: family (general, focuses on members)
- {一家|いっか}: family/household (as a collective unit)
- ⟦{世帯|せたい}→世帯：06870_setai⟧: household (administrative/census term)

USAGE:
Also used with family names: {田中|たなか}{一家|いっか} (the Tanaka family).
